entries.9c8dcd3311320b25: The company states that, with "One Seiryo" as its slogan, it will work to expand corporate value centered on four basic strategies: "expansion of business scale," "establishment of a business foundation," "development of human resources" and "strengthening of its corporate constitution." In its medium-term management plan, it positions the period as one for building a management foundation that can secure stable earnings, with thorough solutions as its axis, and plans to work on deepening existing businesses, developing new businesses, expanding stock businesses, and developing human resources. In the information and communications systems business, it will work on capturing demand for disaster prevention and mitigation and expanding sales of water management systems, and on securing stock businesses such as maintenance, and in the information and communications terminals business, it states that it will continue to create stores chosen by customers and improve after-sales service for terminals.
